final.executive_summary: Hold AAPL and execute nothing at the next open: keep_shares, target_weight_now=null, leaving the position at 7.847568 shares, $2,443 notional and 2.45% of $99,603 equity against $97,160 of cash. All three risk seats independently converged on this action, and the neutral seat's construction is the one I adopt because it is the only internally consistent one: 302–306 accumulation with 302.05 as early warning and a decisive close below 300.00 as hard invalidation, or an add on a close above 320.28 on 65–75M shares with the MACD line back above zero, capped at 5% of equity. No fee is worth paying to resize a 2.45% stub sitting directly under a four-level resistance stack, and the prior 08-14/08-20 round trip (trim 3.30 shares, re-add 2.97 shares, $1.95 of fees) is the concrete cost of confusing motion with edge.
final.investment_thesis:
The business argument is not contested and belongs to the aggressive seat. Nine-month revenue +16.15%, gross margin 46.82% to 49.07% with Q3 at 50.06%, cost of revenue growing 8.6% against 16.4% revenue growth, diluted EPS +22.42% after absorbing a 219bp tax step-up to 17.58%, nine-month FCF +52.5% to $110.2B at 1.15x cash conversion, net cash up $28.5B to $62.2B, $14.4B of debt retired with zero new long-term issuance, D/E 1.34x to 0.78x, and a current ratio back above 1.0x. The conservative seat's own 'where I could be wrong' framing concedes the balance sheet and cash generation are too strong to short. On the franchise, AAPL is a better business than it was a year ago.

The entry argument is equally clear and belongs to the conservative and neutral seats — this is what decides today. First, the 2026-07-31 reconciliation: the market saw these exact numbers and took 7.35% off the stock on 132.5M shares, and price at 311.30 is still 6.64% below that pre-report close and 9.66% below the 07-29 high. The aggressive seat never addressed this; it re-cited the same fundamentals as though the tape had not already voted. Second, the neutral seat's decisive correction of the aggressive reward-to-risk repricing: 2.6:1 is a conditional ratio whose condition has just failed — AAPL opened 317.46 on 2026-08-20, printed 320.28, and closed 311.30, sixty-five cents off the session low — and the 340.56 measured move is derived from the height of a base whose lower boundary is a 132.5M-share gap-down scar, so it is descriptive, not independent confirmation. Third, the 310.69/329.59/333.43/340.56 magnets all sit above a four-level resistance stack at 315.52 / 316.29 / 316.83 / 320.28.

The neutral seat also dismantles the conservative seat's two weakest points, and I adopt both corrections. The proposed invalidation of 'a close below 310.69' for a 302–306 entry is a logical error, not a risk control — it is above the entry and would trigger on day one. And 'four tests weaken the 300.00 floor' is not supported by the tape it cites: the tests are 300.00, 301.32, 300.57 and 302.05, i.e. rising lows with the two most recent above the gap-day print, which is at least as consistent with accumulation as with decay. That ambiguity is exactly why 300.00 belongs as an invalidation level rather than a forecast. Where the conservative seat wins outright is the risk architecture: on 2026-07-31 AAPL closed 333.43 and opened 304.81, so no 300.00 or 299.59 stop would have filled at its level, and a 1.5-ATR stop sitting on a four-times-tested floor is a stop the market knows about. ATR is 7.8075 (2.51%) and there have been two >6% single-day gaps in five weeks.

Where the aggressive seat is right and the conservative seat is wrong: the 90M-share volume gate is miscalibrated. The research desk's number was 65M, about 125% of the 53M 20-day average; 90M is roughly 170%, and the conservative defense of it leans on the 132.5M liquidation day as proof the stock can print volume. A close above 320.28 on 50M shares failed the next day, which argues for 65–75M, not 90M. The neutral seat's midpoint is the correct filter, and it pairs with the MACD line above zero rather than merely above its signal — agreement across all three seats that a sub-zero crossover is counter-trend (MACD line still negative since 2026-08-11).

Sizing resolves to the neutral seat's 5% cap, not 8% and not 3–4%. The aggressive 8% is refused because gross intangibles rose $13.3B against only $1.78B of 'other investing' with no acquisition line — unresolved in both directions, as the neutral seat correctly notes, so it caps size without being bearish. The conservative 3–4% floor is refused because it is a ceiling with no stated add trigger: a framework in which the FY26 10-K resolving the intangibles, Q4 inventory converting raw materials to finished goods, and a confirmed breakout still cannot grow the position is a decision that never has to be made. The unquantified EU take-rate reset (26% IAP, 20% alternative payment, 15% link-out, 5% Core Technology Commission, effective October 1) and Samsung advanced-foundry pricing up to 15% support keeping the cap at 5% rather than raising it; they do not support refusing to own AAPL above 4%.

Why this is a Hold and not a directional call: after weighing, the two sides genuinely split the questions that matter. The bull wins the business, the bear wins the entry, and at 311.30 the unconditional payoff is +2.89% to the 320.28 rejection high against -3.63% to the 300.00 floor with the aggressive repricing being conditional on a level that just rejected. Our own record reinforces inaction over a forced call: the 2026-06-30, 07-01, 07-13, 07-20–07-24 and 08-10/08-11/08-12/08-13 Underweights each bled five-day alpha by trimming a structurally intact name on momentum decay, and the 08-13 Underweight (+3.9% five-day alpha against us while we cut) is the most recent reminder. Nothing here is decisive enough to pay 10bps to trade a $2,443 position.

What would change the call. Upgrade toward Overweight on a close above 320.28 on at least 65–75M shares with the MACD line back above zero, corroborated by Q4 gross margin at or above 50% after the October 1 EU changes and inventory days back under ~12; a Q4 print at or above 50% gross margin after those changes defeats the margin-reversion leg of the bear case. Move toward Underweight/Sell on a decisive close below 300.00 on expanding volume, which breaks the 15-session base with its four higher lows (300.00, 301.32, 300.57, 302.05), confirms the 08-18/08-19 advance as a failed retest and warrants exiting the small holding rather than averaging down; a Q4 gross margin below 48% with a soft guide converts this to Sell.

Evidence gaps, stated rather than papered over: only 20 of 118 eligible news records were supplied with nothing for 2026-08-13 to 08-17; insider activity is unavailable; the ~$13B two-sided intangibles/other-noncurrent-liability movement has no acquisition line in investing cash flow and the supplied data does not resolve it, so the 'IP licensing feeding the moat' reading is an assumption, not evidence; and no options chain is supplied, so any hedge cannot be priced from this set. The $330 target is technical — the 329.59 gap fill and the 333.43 pre-gap close — not valuation-derived, since no consensus or multiple series was provided.
